cases.description: merged (2026-08-15) with what used to be a separate Fan Out To Register node -- an intent with pending registrations now fans out directly into one item per record, each tagged with the shared parent_id/set_active:false/the pre-loop intention_nodes snapshot/has_registrations:true (note: the Tier 1 mock's $().all() only ever returns one item, so this only exercises the single-intent shape -- the real multi-intent flattening is covered by Tier 2)

no pending registrations at all (e.g. every intent failed schema resolution) -> a single {has_registrations: false} placeholder item, not zero items -- Has Registrations?'s own graph input must never be empty
